data.desc: First Citizens Bank is a top 20 U.S. financial institution focused on helping consumers, businesses and entrepreneurs build lasting financial security. Headquartered in Raleigh, N.C., the 125-year-old bank takes a relationship-first approach, delivering specialized expertise and tailored solutions to support its clients' ambitions at every stage of their financial journey. Parent company First Citizens BancShares, Inc. (NASDAQ: FCNCA) is a Fortune 500 company with more than $225 billion in assets. Learn more at firstcitizens.com.
